items.title: Marty Grosz interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 4, 1995
items.q: Marty was interviewed by Monk Rowe in Los Angeles on September 4, 1995.

ctx.x: Marty Grosz is a guitarist and singer who brings to life songs from a bygone era. His totally acoustic approach to music is a welcome change, and a unique brand of humor is an integral part of his numerous recordings. He was born in Germany in 1930 but moved to the U.S. at an early age. The dance bands of the 40s inspired Marty to a career in music and his early bandmates included Dick Wellstood and Art Hodes. He has performed with Soprano Summit and in tributes to the music of Bix Beiderbecke. Marty’s own group…
Marty was interviewed by Monk Rowe in Los Angeles on September 4, 1995.
